title: Embedded circuit gates
statement: Let $D$ be a directed acyclic circuit with $m$ input vertices, let $s$ be a list of source vertices, and let $L$ be a natural number. Replace each gate argument of $D$ by its image under the vertex map that sends $v<m$ to $s_v$ (or $0$ if unavailable) and sends $v\ge m$ to $L+(v-m)$, removing repeated arguments while preserving their order. Append one AND gate whose sole argument is the image of $D$'s output vertex under that map.
